REV 3 (Opus2, 2026-11-14 at about 03:50Z). The main checkout C:\github\Personal\TermAl is DIRTY by Greg's direct word, in Opus3's session.
STAGED: the 17 ui/src paths of the P0 scroll fix w-84132b835175. These are byte-identical to the frozen candidate 274aa3e5 (tree fb4810cc, parent eb78d349); `git diff --cached --quiet 274aa3e5` is empty.
UNSTAGED (Opus3 #797, 03:49Z): 3 ui/src paths for the Response Board change w-8e291dcbe597, which lets cards move and drop at negative positions. They are in main for Greg's live check: ui/src/panels/ResponseBoardPanel.tsx, response-board-camera.ts and ResponseBoardPanel.test.tsx. They do not overlap the 17 staged paths.
Main HEAD is eb78d349 (combo99c landed 02:44:54Z).
RULES:
- Opus2 never stashes, resets or checks out these paths.
- Integration checks for the scroll fix compare the STAGED index against 274aa3e5 only; the 3 unstaged paths are separate and must stay untouched.
- Landings may fast-forward main only when the landing diff overlaps neither the 17 staged nor the 3 unstaged paths.
- OPUS3 (not Opus2) fast-forwards and pushes the scroll fix, after Opus2's GO with the gated commit id (memory opus2-scroll-fix-landing-ruling-2026-11-14).
- Before any RESET NOW, ask Opus3 to clean main first.
Remove this memory once main is clean again.
